boundary: Proposed 2026.10.15.3 learner runtime needs exact-source verification. Real physical iOS/iPadOS and Android devices must be tested by genuine reviewers for installation, offline restart, reboot, update, storage-pressure and zoom. Automated QA is not actual hardware evidence. Real assistive technology remains separate in data/accessibility-real-at-validation-v1.json. Production root, signing, provider authority and machine control remain HOLD.
privacyBoundary: Public contract metadata must not include learner names, customer/site identifiers, email addresses, private screenshots, raw process data, backup content, filesystem/user paths or other personal/proprietary evidence. Keep detailed device evidence outside the public repository and reference it only with a non-sensitive review identifier.
